AnyAPI.Description: Native mod framework for Anymaker 0.1.27; faster scene reads, the game's own clock and weather for sky and lights, crash-safe graphics passes, and new scene services (lighting 4, effects 3, controls 4, antialiasing 3, timing 2, GPU info 2) for graphics mods.

AnyGraphics.Description: Graphics overhaul with ocean reflections, smoother local lights, defaults picked for your GPU and presets from Off to Cinematic plus Soft & warm and Custom, grouped in Show/Hide sub-menus: TAA, tone mapping and colour looks, light colour, shading, shadows, sky and wind in trees, depth of field, motion blur and photo mode, plus ThirdPerson's F5 third-person camera. Each piece can be switched off in Mod Settings. Anymaker 0.1.27 only.
